task: Hey, thanks for coming over to the TextWorld today, there is something I need you to do for me. First of all, you could, like, travel north. With that done, take a trip east. With that accomplished, go south. Then, make an attempt to move south. Following that, try to head south. After that, make an effort to venture south. And then, make an effort to move east. Next, take a trip east. Then, make an attempt to head north. After that, go north. Then, try to take a trip west. Then, pick up the bug from the floor of the pantry. Once that's all handled, you can stop!
description:
